title: Register a client application
content_data:
Use this endpoint to register a client application with the authorization server and receive a `client_id`. You only need to register once, and then you can reuse the returned `client_id` for every subsequent authorization request. # Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/{server}/oauth/register/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| | Content-Type {Required} | string | Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Path parameters** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |server {Required}|string|The specific TikTok for Business MCP server URL.

Enum values: `tt-ads-mcp-flat`, `tt-ads-mcp-layer`.

To learn more about how these server URLs differ, see [Choose your server URL](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/how-to-connect-a-custom-agent-to-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3#anchor-3).| ``` **Body parameters** ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |client_name {Required}|string|The human-readable name of your client application. Provide a non-empty string after trimming.

Length limit: 128 characters.| |redirect_uris {Required}|string[]|A list of redirect URIs (callback URLs) for your client application.

These act as the allowed "return addresses" where the server will redirect the user along with the authorization code after they grant access.

Max size: 5.

Length limit per URI: 1024 characters.

Provide non-empty URIs that include a scheme, omitting any fragments (`#...`) or user info (`user:pass@...`). You may use `http://` exclusively for loopback hosts (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `::1`), while `javascript:`, `data:`, and `file:` schemes are strictly rejected.| |token_endpoint_auth_method|string|The authentication method for the token endpoint.

Enum value:
  • `none`: You do not need to provide a client secret or additional authentication credentials.

Default value: `none`.| |grant_types|string[]|The requested methods for granting tokens.

Enum values:
  • `authorization_code`: To exchange an authorization code for an access token.
  • `refresh_token`: To exchange your refresh token for a new access token..

Default value: `["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]`.| |response_types|string[]|The list of requested response types.

Enum value:
  • `code`: You will receive an authorization code to exchange for a token.

Default value: `["code"]`.| ``` ## Example > **Note**
> The example below uses `tt-ads-mcp-layer` as the `{server}` value. You can replace this with your chosen server value. ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer/oauth/register' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "client_name": "{{client_name}}", "redirect_uris": [ "{{redirect_uri}}" ], "token_endpoint_auth_method": "none", "grant_types": [ "authorization_code", "refresh_token" ], "response_types": [ "code" ] }' (/code) ``` # Response A successful registration returns HTTP `201 Created`. ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| |client_id|string|The registered client ID assigned to your client application.| |client_id_issued_at|integer|The time when the client registration occurred, in the format of an Epoch/Unix timestamp in seconds.

Example: 1784928815.| |redirect_uris|string[]|The list of registered redirect URIs associated with your client application.| |token_endpoint_auth_method|string|The token endpoint authentication method assigned to your registration.

Enum value:
  • `none`: You do not need to provide a client secret or additional authentication credentials.
| |grant_types|string[]|The list of grant types configured for your client.

Enum values:
  • `authorization_code`: To exchange an authorization code for an access token.
  • `refresh_token`: To get a new access token when the old one expires.
| |response_types|string[]|The list of response types configured for your application.

Enum value:
  • `code`: You will receive an authorization code to exchange for a token.
| ``` ## Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "client_id": "{{client_id}}", "client_id_issued_at": 1784928815, "grant_types": [ "authorization_code", "refresh_token" ], "redirect_uris": [ "{{redirect_uri}}" ], "response_types": [ "code" ], "token_endpoint_auth_method": "none" } (/code) ``` ## Error response A failure returns HTTP `400 Bad Request`. ```xtable |Field{28%}|Data Type{18%}|Description{54%}| |---|---|---| | error | string | Error code.
Registration validation failures return `invalid_client_metadata`. | | error_description | string | The human-readable description of the error. | ```
seo_title: Register a TikTok for Business MCP server client application
seo_description: Use this endpoint to register a client application with the TikTok for Business MCP authorization server and receive a client_id.
